instruction: Each color region has one capybara. Double-tap the only cell in this region.
title: Find the first capybara

instruction: This row already has its capybara. Tap the highlighted space to mark X.
title: Tap to mark X

instruction: Tap the same X again to remove it.
title: Tap again to undo

instruction: One capybara per row. Swipe across these spaces to mark X.
title: Swipe across a row

instruction: One capybara per column. Swipe down these spaces to mark X.
title: Swipe down a column

instruction: One capybara per row and column. Mark the remaining highlighted spaces with X.
title: Cross out the remaining spaces

instruction: Capybaras cannot touch, even diagonally. Mark these neighboring cells with X.
title: Give them space

instruction: The X marks leave only one space in this row. Double-tap to find its capybara.
title: One space left in this row

instruction: Capybaras cannot touch, even diagonally. Mark these neighboring cells with X.
title: Give them space

instruction: The X marks leave only one space in this region. Double-tap to find its capybara.
title: One space left in this region

instruction: One capybara left. Find it yourself, or tap Hint if you need a hand.
title: Find the last capybara
